If `steersman_dampened_by_saturn.is_active` or `steersman_in_private_house` is TRUE, you MUST override extroverted stereotypes (like Leo or Aries). 3. MODULATE TONE BASED ON INTENSITY & TRAJECTORY: - If the Saturnian dampening is "Extreme" (Orb 0-3°), describe the native as highly guarded and defensive. If "Mild", describe it as a healthy background caution. - If the aspect is "Applying", the structural restriction is actively escalating and demands conscious effort. If "Separating", it is a restriction they have mostly learned to navigate and outgrow. 4. ASCENDANT DEGREE SATURN ASPECT (PHYSICAL BODY CONTRACTION): Check `ascendant_dampened_by_saturn`. If active, Saturn applies physical contraction, self-consciousness, or structural tension to the native's physical body and outer presentation in public environments. Describe how Saturnian physical contraction can manifest across different somatic forms (e.g. posture tension, physical guardedness, cautious movement, or feeling visible physical pressure under public scrutiny) without hardcoding single literal symptoms. 5. Output a highly detailed, bulleted report on the "Mechanics of the Chart" combining these vectors. DO NOT interpret deep psychological trauma or the Solar-Lunar blend—leave that to Agent 2.
